profile.name: Lucas Huang
profile.title: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary: I'm a software developer focused on AI, web, and mobile applications. I enjoy understanding what people need and turning their ideas into software that is useful and easy to work with. I like to stay involved from early discussions through delivery, working closely with clients and teams as the product takes shape. I value clear communication, thoughtful design, and the willingness to keep learning and improving along the way.

highlights: Built borrower, lender, and administrator workflows for a Los Angeles mortgage-loan broker using Preact and Bun.
Deployed on Cloudflare with relational data, real-time messaging, and document storage using D1, Durable Objects, and R2.
Expanded WordPress landing pages into a PHP and PostgreSQL membership platform for the Irish Institute of Pensions Management.
Automated onboarding, qualification reviews, course-progress tracking, annual membership payments, and PDF certificate generation.
Built the Media Pipe and Aegis Android applications and integrated detection alerts, evidence clips, and Twilio call workflows with the HeroEyez portal.
Adapted firearm detection for edge devices using TensorFlow Lite and trained and tested with more than 10,000 images; deployed the application in June 2025.
